keyword_evidence: SERP_ONLY: public marketplace/category pages show personalized teacher classroom rugs, back-to-school welcome mats, custom classroom doormats, teacher-name decor and school-season entry rugs. No paid volume, Search Console, or internal search data used.
buyer_summary: Buyer intent is a hypothesis from product evidence plus category SERP language: teachers and gift buyers want personalized back-to-school classroom rugs that welcome students, show teacher/classroom identity, and add colorful decor for entry, reading, or circle-time spaces.
purchase_concerns: Teacher-name spelling, classroom wording readability, size fit, non-slip backing, washability or cleaning expectations, material feel, classroom age fit, and whether the design matches the teacher's preferred style or back-to-school theme.
